title: chore(deps): update kjanat/actionlint action to v1.17.1
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Type | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| [kjanat/actionlint](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint) | action | patch | `v1.17.0` → `v1.17.1` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>kjanat/actionlint</summary>

### [`v1.17.1`](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint/releases/tag/v1.17.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint/compare/v1.17.0...v1.17.1)

actionlint 1.17.1 updates the Go toolchain and container packages to address the vulnerabilities reported in [#​356](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint/issues/356). It also fixes validation of actions at the repository root. This is a small maintenance release for v1; configuration and check defaults are unchanged.

#### Upgrade to patched binaries and images

The release binaries, Docker images, and Nix package now build with Go 1.27.3, including its standard-library security fixes. Docker images also update their installed Alpine packages.

The release workflow now checks Go packages with govulncheck and scans the Docker smoke-test images with OSV Scanner before publication. Thanks [@​konard](https://redirect.github.com/konard) for reporting the vulnerable packages in the 1.17.0 image. Related: [#​356](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint/issues/356).

#### Call an action at the repository root

A step using `uses: $/` now resolves to the repository's root action instead of producing an invalid-format error. For a repository with an `action.yml` or `action.yaml` at its root:

```yaml
steps:
  - uses: $/
    with:
      message: hello
```

actionlint reads that action's metadata and validates its inputs and outputs. Unknown input names and references to undeclared outputs still produce diagnostics. Thanks [@​mattdowdell](https://redirect.github.com/mattdowdell) for reporting the problem and identifying its cause in [#​199](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint/issues/199). Fixed in [#​200](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint/issues/200).

#### Upgrade

```sh
npm install --save-dev @kjanat/actionlint@1.17.1
```

For a one-off run:

```sh
npx @kjanat/actionlint@1.17.1 -version
```

For Docker:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/kjanat/actionlint:1.17.1
```

For the GitHub Action:

```yaml
- uses: kjanat/actionlint@v1.17.1
```

Release archives, SHA-256 checksums, and SBOMs are attached below. See the [installation guide](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint/blob/v1.17.1/docs/install.md) for other installation methods.

[Full changelog](https://redirect.github.com/kjanat/actionlint/compare/v1.17.0...v1.17.1)

</details>
